column6: Lossy: schema:Chapter is WebPageElement-scoped and narrower than gmeow:ContentSegment.

bibo:Book is scholarly-publication-scoped; gmeow:LiteraryWork is universal.

Wikidata 'myth' (type of traditional narrative) — close match to gmeow:Myth.
Wikidata 'conspiracy theory' — close match to gmeow:Myth as a socially-sustained narrative whose currency is independent of truth-value.
Wikidata 'urban legend' (form of modern folklore) — close match to gmeow:Myth.
